_comment: Durable friction baselines: fixed-script E2E flows measured BEFORE the logging-speed round (workspace at 2d50778: no guided carry-forward, unconditional auto-focus, no swap resume). Each probe in friction-baseline.spec.js runs the identical script and must come in AT or UNDER every baseline metric — regressions fail the suite. Wall-clock timings are apparatus timings (Playwright speed), never human-performance claims, so only deterministic action/focus counts are gated here.
